goal.objective: Read AGENTS.md and all project specification documents, then build a runnable MVP of the review-event yut game service end-to-end. Do not stop at scaffolding, examples, plans, mocks, or TODO-only implementations. Produce working backend, frontend, database/dev environment, customer flow, store-admin flow, deterministic server-authoritative yut results, coupon redemption, and a polished mobile 3D yut animation. Use parallel subagents where work can be safely isolated, integrate their work, run validation, fix failures, and leave the repository in a reviewable runnable state.
goal.clarification_policy: Do not ask the user questions that can be resolved from AGENTS.md, the project documents, existing repository conventions, or a safe MVP default. Ask only when a missing external credential, destructive external action, or irreconcilable requirement truly blocks local implementation.
goal.finish_policy: Continue until all feasible success criteria are satisfied. If one item is impossible because of an external dependency, complete all other items and document the exact blocker and the smallest next action.

mandatory_context.instruction: Before implementation, inspect the repository after reading these files. Reconcile the plan with the code that actually exists. Existing working code has priority over unnecessary rescaﬀolding, while explicit locked business rules in AGENTS.md remain authoritative.

locked_mvp_rules.store_qr: Every store has a separate unguessable public QR token; do not expose sequential store IDs in customer URLs.
locked_mvp_rules.customer_identity: Name and phone number; no SMS verification in MVP.
locked_mvp_rules.cooldown: Per store + normalized phone number, 2 calendar-day cooldown in Asia/Seoul. Example: play on Sep 2 -> next eligible Sep 4 00:00.
locked_mvp_rules.active_coupon_priority: If the customer has an unused coupon at that store, route to the coupon page before permitting another game.
locked_mvp_rules.staff_pin: Each store has a unique random 6-digit numeric staff PIN. PIN is required for game approval and coupon redemption. Never log plaintext PIN.
locked_mvp_rules.probability_control: Server-controlled and not editable by store admins.
locked_mvp_rules.game_integrity: The backend decides and persists the result before reveal. Refresh/retry must never reroll or double-issue a coupon.
locked_mvp_rules.prize_count: Exactly 3 configurable prize tiers in MVP; no inventory limit.
locked_mvp_rules.coupon_validity: 90 days from issuance; snapshot the prize/policy at issue time.
locked_mvp_rules.review_platform: Naver Place MVP. Staff checks that a review exists; never require positive sentiment or a specific star rating.
locked_mvp_rules.admin_model: One admin account may manage multiple stores; system operator creates stores in MVP.
locked_mvp_rules.solapi: Not required for MVP. Keep a notification abstraction so Solapi Kakao Alimtalk can be added later.

parallel_agents.policy: Use subagents for work that divides cleanly. Prefer parallel exploration/review freely. Parallel write agents are allowed only with non-overlapping write ownership. The parent agent owns integration and shared root/config files.
parallel_agents.rule: Every subagent must be spawned with a single valid JSON object as its instruction payload. Do not use vague free-form subagent prompts. The JSON must match parallel_agent_prompt_schema and include explicit allowed write paths and forbidden paths. Ask each subagent to return its final handoff as JSON matching parallel_agent_return_schema.

wave_strategy.purpose: parent creates or normalizes shared scaffolding and dependency manifests
parallel implementation with exclusive path ownership
parent integrates cross-boundary contracts and fixes compile/runtime conflicts
parent fixes findings, runs final validation, updates docs, and reports result

parallel_agents.conflict_rule: Never give two concurrent write agents overlapping allowed_write_paths. If a file must be touched by two workstreams, the parent owns that file or the work is serialized.
parallel_agents.failure_rule: If a subagent fails or returns an incomplete handoff, inspect the cause. Retry once with a refined JSON task if useful; otherwise the parent completes the missing work. Do not abandon the overall goal because one subagent fails.
parallel_agents.unavailable_fallback: If subagent tools are disabled or unavailable in the current Codex runtime, preserve the same wave order and ownership boundaries but execute the workstreams sequentially in the primary thread. Do not stop solely because parallelism is unavailable.

template.objective: One bounded outcome for this agent.
context_files: Exact files this agent should read first.
dependencies: Outputs or assumptions from earlier waves.
allowed_write_paths: Exclusive paths this agent may modify; empty for read-only/review agents.
forbidden_write_paths: Shared/root paths or another agent's ownership.
required_checks: Tests/build/static checks this agent should run if possible.
template.return_format: Return a single valid JSON object matching parallel_agent_return_schema; summarize rather than dumping raw logs.
stop_conditions: Do not expand scope beyond objective.
Stop and report blocker if required change is outside allowed_write_paths.

integration_notes: What the parent agent must know before integration.

orchestrator_rules: The primary Codex thread is the orchestrator and final owner of the repository state.
Read AGENTS.md before this manifest; then read every mandatory_context file before material implementation.
Inspect git status and existing files before editing. Preserve user changes and do not reset/revert unrelated work.
Do not merely create a plan. Implement the product.
Do not stop after backend or frontend alone; integrate both unless an external blocker makes this impossible.
Do not delegate shared configuration files to concurrent writers.
Wait for all agents in a wave before starting dependent integration work.
Subagent summaries are evidence, not authority: the parent must inspect key diffs and run integration validation.
When package/build files need changes requested by a worker, the parent applies them centrally and then tells affected agents or continues integration.
Use safe local defaults for dev-only secrets and document them via .env.example. Never commit real credentials.
Do not deploy to production or perform external paid actions. Local implementation, local containers, tests, and build validation are authorized.
Update source-of-truth docs only when implementation reveals a necessary contract clarification; never silently alter locked product rules.
The immediate deployment target is local Docker Compose on the user's Windows laptop for real in-store testing; implement field-test readiness before considering the goal complete.
Use Nginx as the single ingress and keep the public frontend/backend on one origin to avoid unnecessary CORS dependence on temporary Cloudflare hostnames.
Do not require paid/cloud infrastructure for the initial field-test profile. Cloudflare Quick Tunnel is the temporary public HTTPS entrypoint when external access is needed.
Do not persist temporary trycloudflare.com hostnames as store identity; persist the store token and compose field-test QR URLs from the active public origin.
implementation_sequence: Preflight: read docs, inspect repository, git status, available runtimes and package/build files.
Run wave 0 exploration agents with JSON prompts.
Parent establishes shared scaffold/dependency manifests if needed.
Run wave 2 implementation agents with exclusive write ownership.
Integrate backend/frontend API contracts, environment wiring, and navigation.
Run backend tests and frontend lint/build/test scripts that actually exist.
Start local dependencies and perform practical smoke checks where feasible.
Run wave 4 verification agents with JSON prompts.
Fix material findings and rerun failed validation.
Build and validate the local Docker field-test profile: PostgreSQL + backend + frontend + Nginx, then Cloudflare Quick Tunnel integration/configuration and current-origin QR behavior.
Update README/run instructions and provide final completion report.

success_criteria: Repository contains runnable integrated frontend and backend rather than only documentation or stubs.
Local developer can follow README instructions to configure environment, start dependencies, run backend, and run frontend.
All locked MVP rules are represented in implementation and tests where practical.
Staff PIN approval and redemption controls work.
2 calendar-day cooldown and active-coupon precedence work.
Fixed 65/25/10 tier distribution is implemented server-side as 32.5/32.5/12.5/12.5/10 yut outcomes.
Game result is server-authoritative, persistent, and resistant to reroll/double issuance.
Customer receives a 90-day coupon with correct policy snapshot and atomic one-time redemption.
Admin can manage multiple stores, their prizes, QR, PIN and view MVP activity.
3D yut experience is functional, mobile-oriented and physically animated with deterministic final result correction.
Relevant tests/build/lint checks pass, or any unavoidable external blocker is precisely documented with all other work complete.
A Windows laptop can run the complete MVP in a deployment-like Docker Compose configuration for immediate in-store testing.
Nginx provides one origin for frontend and backend and is the only intended application ingress.
The repository includes a free Cloudflare Quick Tunnel field-test path and exact instructions for finding the temporary public HTTPS URL.
Temporary tunnel hostname changes do not corrupt store identity; test QR codes can be regenerated against the active public origin.

final_report_contract.rule: Do not claim a test/build passed unless it was actually run successfully. Keep raw logs out of the final response; summarize them.

goal_invocation.interpretation: Treat the goal objective as a pointer to this execution manifest. Read AGENTS.md first, then this JSON, then mandatory_context, and execute the manifest end-to-end.

repair_loop.rule: After integration, run validation. For every material failure, diagnose and fix the root cause, then rerun the relevant check. Continue until checks pass or a genuine external blocker remains.
repair_loop.stagnation_stop: If the exact same failure repeats three times without new evidence or progress, stop retrying that failure, document it precisely, and complete every independent success criterion before final reporting.
